effects.title: Hello
effects.summary: The smallest effect: a few hundred soft flakes falling straight down, one instanced draw through the HDR tail, over the page. Every later effect starts from this shape.

scorecard.fallback: A still of the flakes, or a few CSS-animated dots.

effects.title: Blizzard
effects.summary: A whiteout: blowing snow as a volume of wind-stretched streamers, ray-marched through depth so the far page fades into white, with dense driven flakes in front. Gusts sweep across, closing the view and clearing it again.

scorecard.fallback: A still of the whiteout, or a white gradient over the page.
useCases: A weather or outdoor brand page

effects.title: Snow globe
effects.summary: A snow globe over a small winter scene: drag or click to shake it, and its flakes swirl in the water, then sink slowly and settle on the scene until the next shake. The water-filled glass magnifies the scene inside like a lens, with a bright rim and a window highlight.

scorecard.fallback: A still of the globe with its snow settled.
useCases: A product hero for a gift or seasonal page

effects.title: Snowfall
effects.summary: Snow falling through depth over the page: flakes sized from an exponential distribution, falling at their terminal speed, drifting with gusts that sweep across and swirling with their neighbours. Far flakes keep their light as they shrink to points; near ones streak over a shutter time.

scorecard.fallback: A still of the snow, or CSS snow for a few dozen flakes.

effects.title: Footprints
effects.summary: A snow surface the pointer walks across: each step packs the snow down into a print and pushes it aside into a raised rim, rims slump to the angle of repose, and falling snow slowly fills the prints again. Lit by a low sun, so hollows read as blue shadow. With no pointer, someone walks across on their own.

scorecard.fallback: A still of a trail of prints.
useCases: A ground strip along the foot of a hero

effects.title: Melt
effects.summary: Snow on the page's elements melting: each pile slumps as it wets, thins fastest where it is thinnest, so it pulls back from the ends, and drips off them. It melts to nothing, then snows again; or it melts as the page scrolls.

scorecard.fallback: A still of the snow, or the CSS ridge (src/css/snow-ridge.css) shrinking on a transition.

effects.title: Settling snow
effects.summary: Snow that settles on the page's own elements: a pile along the top of every heading, card and button, built column by column as it falls, sliding to its angle of repose, blown into a cornice at the lee end, and lit with blue shadows so it reads on a white page. The pointer brushes it off; a press shakes an element's snow loose.

scorecard.fallback: CSS: a ridge of snow on each element (src/css/snow-ridge.css), with no settling.
useCases: A winter promotion over a real layout
